content: Day Jisasaam kwurin kariyadaad Paylatak.
Ganib tilik, ababa sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw Jisasaam yaav jikuw, kwurin karaydaad Rom dayadi sapakwa duw, Paylatak.
Juwtas di dikim viyasipaad.

Juwtas, di Jisasaam dikidiy mama nibak kwiydidi duw, vidik, Jisasaam viyasipaak, aban takadaak, di samasam wukikuw, dikidiy kwurdidiy saan duwamiy nak sap tabatiy sibinin karaydidiy adiy sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugwak.
Juwtas dayak wadidiy, “Wun Jisasaam kipakip gwurak kwatiya-tuwaad. Di simsim vaal maa ti. Alik vaal yidiwun.” Day wadiy, “Aal mina yawiya, nyana yawiy maa.”
Juwtas adiy saan God dikidi wiyaar yakisawulakuw, di yikuw, yaav kwaliyapaam silikiykuw, bwutaay kiyaad.
Adiy sapakwa nyanugw pris adiy saan kwurkuw, wadiy, “Kidiy sanaar duw yapiy-banaad kiyadikik. Alik kidiy saan God diki yawiyik kwar maa.”
Maaj lakatiykuw, adiy saan kwurkuw, kupwa vaak kwurda duw diki kupw yapiydaal, nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw daya kawamiy tilikikik.
Aw alik, “Nyikiy kupw,” wakwadana ki nyaar ab.
Jirimaya, God diki maaj wasapwiydi duw, ki God diki lapa nyigaam sukwudil maaj ata mwiya mwiyab tal. Kitawa sukwudil,

content.text: “Adiy saan duwamiy nak sap tabatiy kwurdadiy. Yisrayil jaka tipa kidiy duw duwaam yapiyik tasakwudadiy saan-adiy.
Day kupwa vaak kwurda duw diki kupw yapiydaal. Yitaypika Duw God wunak atawa wadidiwun kwurtuwkik.”

content: Paylat Jisasak bas sidid dikidiy yawiyik.
Jisas ata Rom dayadi taay maaj lakwudi gavman duw, Paylat, diki mwutamaam tad. Paylat Jisasak bas sidid, “Min Juw dayadi sapakwa nyan-adimin?” Jisas ata wadid, “Ayiy, wamina maja pik.”

Adiy sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw day maa wakuw Jisasak, alik sukwupir maaj kwiydaal Paylatak dikik. Aw Jisas dayadiy wadadiy jaav maa kwar. Aw di maaj maa wu adiy javik. Kip kaygan tad.
Paylat Jisasak ata bas sidid, “Min awuk! Day samasama maaj sukwupirkuw, minak wanadiy. Min maaj maa?”
Jisas niki maaj maa wu. Alik Paylat diki mawul nikim nikim tal.
Paylat tasakwudil day Jisasaam viyasipadakik.
Ababa God Wapadidiy Nyi bayaki kikipata nyaam, Paylat kalabus im kwadi duw nak wapadid. Sikadad vagaluwdiy duw taakw bas sidadiy dikik, di ata wapadid dayak.
Adi nabiy duw nak, dikidi si Barapas, kalabus im kwaad. Ababa duw taakw dikim lakwiyaki-daad.
Duw taakw samasam vagaluwdaak, Paylat ata bas sididiy, “Sikadi duw gwurak kwatiyaaw? Barapas wapa-kituwaad, ay?” Jisas, adi wadanadi God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw-ad wapa-kituwaad, ay?
Paylat wukidil sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw dayadiy mawul kuwkuw nadaak Jisasak, day Jisas kwiydaad dikik.
Paylat kot aam kwadik, diki taakw ki maaj kwiylil dikik, “Wadi viyakita duwaam kupwarapa jaav dikim kwur-tikwa. Wun gaan dikik yigin vilwun. A yiginik samasam wukinawun.”
Adiy sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugw vagaluwdiy duw takwak nimadib wadiy, day Paylatak bas sidakikik Barapasaam wapadikik dayak aw Jisasaam viyasipa-dikik.
Aw Paylat dayak bas sididiy maa, “Kibir duwaam, sikadaad gwurak kwatiya-kituwaad?” Aw day wadiy, “Barapas nyanak akwutay.”
“Agwa jaav kwurkinadiwun kidi wadanadi God dikidi Tasakwudidi Duw Jisasak?” Paylat ata bas sididiy. Day abab gaam sidiy, “Maap tinadi miyaam dim akat!”
Paylat dayak ata bas sad, “Agwa kupwarapa jaav kwurdil?” Day mwiya nimadib gaam sidiy, “Maap tinadi miyaam dim akat!”

Paylat dayadiy mawulaam warapiy warapiy maa rav vidil, aw dayadiy mawul wariyak mawul warin tidiy. Diki taab jankuw dayadiy mwutamaam, ata wadidiy, “Wun wunabir taab abira jantuwabir. Alik gwur vikuw, wukikigwura Jisas kiyakida vaal wuna yawiy maa. Aal gwura yawiya.”

Adiy vagaluwdiy duw taakw dikik ata wataykuw, wadaad, “Wa kiyakida vaal nyanadiy nyanugwawa nyanak yakwa.” Paylat Barapasaam wapadik dayak, di Jisas vay sawdiy duwak kwiydid ramiy tidi miyaar taay viyadakik aw ginyir maap tidi miyaam katadaad.
Vay sawdiy duw sapis jikin kwurdiy Jisasak.
Paylat dikidiy vay sawdiy duw day Jisas taay maaj lakwudi gavman duw dikid wiya yaripaar kwurin kawuladaad. Wulakuw, day gaam sidiy nuwukadiy vay sawdiy duwak day yadakikik dayak.

Day alataab kwurik Jisasaam. Alik taay kwusuwin tididiy wapwiy kaypwutiydaak, day yitaypika duw nyikiy nyikiy wapwiy kitika wapwiy rabwutaka-daad. Atawa day yitaypika duw abwa wawiy pik kwurkuw, diki abwaam kititakadaal. Aw a abwa wawiy ramiy til abwa wawiyim. Miy nak diki mava tabaam takadaal. Alataab kwurin kwatiyir sikuw dikik, day ata wadaad, “Juw dayad yitaypika duw, nabiy samasam kwakinadimin.”
Ata wakuw, diki sipaam likasip satakaan, adi miy kwurkuw, diki abwaam viyadaad.
Taay apaapap kwurin naykuw, day nyikiy nyikiy wapwiy kaylapwiykuw, di diki wapwiy alib dim rabwutaka-daad. Day Jisas ata kwurin karaydaad maap tidi miyaam katadakik.
Day Jisas maap tidi miyaam katadaad.
Kawaar yidaak, duw nak Sayman, Sayriniy tipa kid, vidaad. Vay sawdiy duw wadaak, Sayman di Jisas dikidi maap tidi miy yatadid.
Day Jisas kwurkuw, tip si Juw daya kapa tipa majir Galgata, adi tipaar wakwudiy. Tip si maw maaj duw adakap kitika tamiya.
Alim day wain awa nyigiy yina marasin biraay kitik kwiyik kidikikik dikim yil kagilik. Aw Jisas viyik kikitaan vikuw, kwasik yad.
Day Jisas maap tidi miyaam ata katadaad. Katakuw, dikidiy wapwiy am sidadiy day dayadiy. Day jib kwadiy kwasadiy kabaak yakitaay tayaan, naydiy adiy wapwiy kwurik.
Atawa kwurkuw, day daan rikuw, dikik van tidiy.
Jisas apiy abwawa maaj sukwupirkuw dikik sukwudaal, “JUW DAYADI YITAYPIKA DUWAD.”
Luwkuw kwurin duw viyaan kwurbir duw day maap tibir miyaam katadabir Jisasawa, nak diki mava tabaam, nak diki akiy tabaam.
Wajibayin kwurdiy Jisasak.

Walibab tiytiyan tidiy duw Jisasak abwugar nayin wajibayin kwurdiy, “A! Min God dikidi wiy pirakanadi duw-adimin! Pirakakuw, nyi mugwul yidaak, kitampika wiy kwurkimina! Li, ‘Wun God dikidi Nyan-adiwun,’ wamina, yaakiya min mina kap kwurkuw, maap tinadi miy wapakuw, adiyid!”

Atawa sapakwa nyanugw pris awa God diki lo kalivadiy duwawa adiy Juw dayadiy sapakwa nyanugwawa day wadiy, “Di nuwukadiy duw taakw sugwiyaan kwurkwada. Aw di dikik maa rav. Li kidi duw Yisrayil dayadi Yitaypika Duw tida, aka maap tinadi miy wapakuw, dadik, aw nyan vikuw, dikik wukijibiran tikinadiyan. Di Godak wukijibir, God dikidi Nyan-ad wakuw, yaakiya, nyan vinaak God dim nyigil-kidaad ay maa.”
Abir Jisasawa maap tibir miyaam katadabir duw ab wajibaybir Jisasak.
Jisas bwu kiyaad.
Nyidi nyi tidik, yin nyi tikitakiy-dik, miyawa tamiy gaan kitik tad.
Nyi tikitakiy-dik, Jisas di diki kapa tipa majir nimadib gaam sad, “Yilay, Yilay, lama sapaktaniy?” Ki maaj maw maaj, “Wunadi God, wunadi God, agwak min wunaam wapamina?”
Nuwukadiy walibab tidiy duw ata wadiy, “Awuk! Kidi duw God diki maaj wasapwiydi duw, Yilayjaak gaam sinaad.”
Duw nak gipakuw, nyigiy yila wain diyuwim takadik, yavim takakuw, kwiydil Jisas kidikikik.
Aw nuwukadiy wadiy, “Ataada! Nyan vinaak God dikidi tayir kidi kupwaam kwadi maaj wasapwiydi duw Yilayja yakuw, di Jisas kwurin karda-kidaad, ay maa.”
Jisas nimadib gaam sikuw, ata kiyaad.

Nimadi wapwiy God dikidi wiyaam nyidi wiyaam mwiya kapaba tamiy takatipin tad. Tipa takaan aluwurib ap vitiy pirakiykuw, aluwurib daad. God atawa kwurdil miyawa duw takwak simakak day jaaw dikik yikwadiy. Nimadi nanaaw yakuw, kupw miyawa nayakitaay tayidik, kabaak wutatadiy.
A nyi nuwukadiy kawamiy wutatadaak, God adiy kawamiyaam ridiy duw taakw day God dikidiy-adiy kirapitaka-didiy.
Day adiy kawamiy wapakuw, yidaak, ginyir God Jisasaam kirapitakakuw, day Jiruwsalimaar yidiy. Alim duw taakw samasam vidadiy.

Vay sawdiy duw duwamiy tabab dayak van tidi duw nuwukadiy vay sawdiy duwawa day Jisasak van tidiy adi nanaaw vikuw nuwukadiy javiwa, day pitaan samasam wardiy. Pitaan warkuw, ata wadiy, “Kidi duw God dikid mwiya duwa nyanad.”

Samasama v 52 A nyi nuwukadiy kawamiy wuttaakw kwasa sikaam tan vidiy. Maria Maktala tipa kil, Maria Jamisawa Jawsis biraki amaay, Sipatiy dikibir nyidiy biraki amaay, adiy taakw dayawa tidiy. Tayir Jisas Galiliy wapakuw, day diki kwukib yadiy sugwiyaan kwurik dikik.
Jawsip Jisas diki amwiy dipwu kabakim takadil.
Giraab tidik, Jawsip, Aramatiya tipa kid yad. Di saan samasam tidi duw-ad. Dibab Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw nak-ad.
Di Paylatak wulaan walibab tad Jisas amwiyik bas sikir. Paylat ata wadidiy, “Jisas diki amwiy Jawsipak akwiy.”
Aw Jawsip Jisas diki amwiy kwurkuw, rabwutakadil viyakita wamakawam wapwiyir.
Rabwutakakuw, Jawsip Jisas diki amwiy di diki vadil kwula dipwu kabakim takadil. Di nima kabaak timilyikuw, ata dipwu kabaak diki daap tipin takadil.
Maria, Maktala tipa kilwa niki Maria walibab daan rikuw, a jaav vibiril.
Vay sawdiy duw adi dipwu kabakik van tidiy.

God Wapadidiy bayaki kikipaat kwulapwu-dana nyi tilik, sira pik, adiy sapakwa nyanugw pris awa Parasiy bapa duw day Paylatawa vagaluwkuw, wadaad, “Sapakwa duw, nyan wukibana adi suwaal takadidi duw Jisas, kidi kupwaam kwadik waad, ‘Wun kiyakuw, nyi mugwul yidaak, God wunaam kirapitaka-kidadiwun.’

“Min maaj akwiy kidiy vay sawdiy duwak adi dipwu kabakim van tidakikik nyi mugwul. Aw adiy dikidiy kalivadidiy duw yakuw, dikidi amwiy luwkuw kwurkuw, yin tipa duw takwak suwaal takakuw, wakik-nadiy, ‘Jisasaam God bwutaay kirapitaka-daad.’ Jisas takadil suwaal, ‘God wunaam kirapitaka-kidadiwun,’ aal kupwaraapa. Aw li Jisas dikidiy kalivadidiy duw Jisas dikidi amwiy luwkuw kwurkuw, wakidana, ‘God Jisasaam bwutaay kirapitaka-daad,’ aal mwiya kupwaraap tikina.”
Paylat ata wadidiy, “Gwur gwuradiy vay sawdiy duw kwurkuw, yin adi dipwu kabakim gwur gwura van ada.”
Aw day yikuw, adi dipwu kabakim takatipikuw, ata vay sawdiy duw takadadiy van tidakikik.
